title: Public Alert No. 028/2026- Recall Of Children’s Ibuprofen Oral Suspension in the United States Due To Potential Contamination With Foreign Material

products.manufacturer: Strides Pharma Inc., India (for Taro Pharmaceuticals U.S.A., Inc.)

summary: USFDA recall of ~90,000 bottles of Children's Ibuprofen Oral Suspension USP 100 mg/5 mL (lots 7261973A, 7261974A) by Strides Pharma due to foreign material ('gel-like mass', 'black particles'). Distributed in the US only; NAFDAC is conducting surveillance to keep it out of Nigeri
